1. (Currently Amended) A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; a plurality of ultrasound radiating members positioned within the energy delivery section, the plurality of ultrasound radiating members being allocated into electrical groups comprising more than one ultrasound radiating member; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group; __and wherein the ultrasound radiating members are configured to operate at a frequency greater than 100 kHz__.

2. (Currently Amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of ultrasound radiating members are mounted on an inner core, wherein the inner core is configured for insertion into the tubular body; __and wherein the inner core comprises a piezoelectric material__.

3. (Currently Amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, further comprising at least one therapeutic compound delivery lumen that extends through the tubular body and terminates at least one outlet positioned in the energy delivery section; __wherein the at least one therapeutic compound delivery lumen is configured to deliver a thrombolytic agent__.

4. (Currently Amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a regular pattern; __and wherein adjacent ultrasound radiating members of different electrical groups are separated by a distance of less than 1 mm__.

5. (Currently Amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a pseudo random pattern; __and wherein the pseudo random pattern is generated according to a mathematical algorithm__.

6. (Currently Amended) A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: a first and a second ultrasound catheters, each of the first and the second ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen; and a control system is connected to and configured to operate both __the first and the second ultrasound catheters__.

7. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 6, wherein the control system operates both the first and the second ultrasound catheters simultaneously.

8. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 7, wherein the control system is configured to independently control the ultrasound radiating members on the first and the second ultrasound catheters.

9. (Currently Amended) A method for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the method comprising: advancing an ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen; advancing the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter to a treatment site in the patient's pulmonary artery; inflating a balloon on the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter; delivering a thrombolytic drug to the treatment site through the at least one fluid delivery lumen; and emitting ultrasonic energy __at a frequency greater than 100 kHz__ to thereby promote diffusion of the thrombolytic drug at the treatment site.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 9, wherein delivering the thrombolytic drug and emitting ultrasonic energy are performed simultaneously; __and wherein the ultrasonic energy enhances penetration of the thrombolytic drug into the thrombus__.

11. (Currently Amended) An ultrasound catheter for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen, the tubular body defining a guidewire lumen extending through the proximal portion and the ultrasound energy delivery section; __wherein the at least one ultrasound element comprises a plurality of interdigitated ultrasound radiating members allocated into electrical groups__.

12. (Currently Amended) The ultrasound catheter of Claim 11, wherein the guidewire lumen extends through the at least one ultrasound element; __and wherein the guidewire lumen is positioned centrally within the ultrasound energy delivery section__.

13. (Currently Amended) The ultrasound catheter of Claim 11, further comprising at least one balloon positioned at the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter; __wherein the at least one balloon is configured to occlude the pulmonary artery during treatment__.
